cautions: DEM10B is approximately 10m contour-derived data; mirror update date is not a common survey year.
Downloaded zoom9 tiles are averaged/resampled. Derived max is the maximum available sampled pixel, not the original 10m DEM maximum.
All downloaded pixels are opaque. Zero metres includes sea/missing fill and genuine zero-elevation land; a separate coastline is needed.
Coastline masking is limited by the chosen polygon resolution; cells without land-centre DEM samples remain explicitly missing.
